inspiration.observed_pattern: NATURAL RIGHT JOIN exposes shared key columns as one unqualified result column while preserving unmatched rows from the right relation.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one matching row and one right-only row across two independently authored tables. The minimized statement removes latest-per-group aggregation and isolates the unqualified shared-key projection and right-side NULL extension.

fixture_notes: Catalog device 11 matches one reading; catalog device 22 has no reading and must remain with a non-NULL shared device_id and NULL reading value. The query must not expose a NULL shared key for the preserved right row.
determinism_notes: Device IDs and values are fixed, and output is ordered by the unique catalog device ID with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE reading_snapshot (device_id INT NOT NULL, reading INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE device_catalog (device_id INT PRIMARY KEY, device_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT device_id, device_name, reading FROM reading_snapshot NATURAL RIGHT JOIN device_catalog ORDER BY device_id

checks.sql: SELECT device_id, device_name FROM device_catalog ORDER BY device_id
SELECT device_id, reading FROM reading_snapshot ORDER BY device_id
